Step three of the sign-in form: the account's licenses with their tier and seat meter, full licenses without a radio, Replace a device as a step in place, and the key field. License origins are described in plain words, and a grant that expires while the step is open returns to sign-in.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    **Drop-in.** Step 3 of the form, when the inputs carry I-04's view: rows with the tier pill, `{used} of {limit} devices`, the origin in plain words and the term; Replace a device in place, confirmed in the system dialog.

    **Styled part.** `LicenseChoiceView(screen:choices:)` and `ReplaceDeviceView(screen:view:onReplace:)`.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.licenseChoice(_:)` over `KitLicenseChoices` and `KitReplaceView`.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
